ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity substrate (~85% black/dark-grey) contrasted by high-intensity white features (~15%) across linear abrasions and lateral tip clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white clusters concentrated at the extreme lateral distal tips (left and right margins); extensive stochastic distribution of high-intensity linear filaments across the central and lateral dark zones of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the trailing edge with varying pixel-amplitude; right lobe exhibits higher frequency saw-tooth peaks compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory originating from the medial region, tapering into a lateral extension at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of approximately circular high-contrast white pixel groups located exclusively at the terminal fluke tips, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Complex network of multi-directional, intersecting high-contrast white linear paths (rake marks) densely covering the majority of the visible surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) across the ventral surface and heavy epibiotic (barnacle) encrustation at both fluke tips.
